title: John the Baptist
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The learner elaborates the annunciation and birth of John (Luke 1:5-25, 57-66), relates it to the coming Messiah, interprets John's description of Jesus (Luke 3:16: more powerful, baptises with the Holy Spirit and fire; John 1:29-30: the Lamb of God who takes away sin) and discusses John's message (Luke 3:7-18: repent, bear fruit, share, be honest, be content).

floor.question: What did John tell people with two coats?
floor.answer: Share with one who has none

steps: John describes Jesus: more powerful, Lamb of God.
John's message: repent and bear fruit.
contexts: a herald before a leader's visit

board.do: Write John 1:29: "Look, the Lamb of God".
Wait for the learner to say Jesus would be the sacrifice for sin.
Write Luke 3:16 below and discuss it.

misconceptions.ask: Who were the parents of John the Baptist?
misconceptions.repair: Draw two families: Zechariah and Elizabeth (John); Joseph and Mary (Jesus).
Read Luke 3:15-16: John said one more powerful was coming.

listen_for: That it was enough to be saved
misconceptions.ask: What did John say about being children of Abraham (Luke 3:8)?
misconceptions.repair: Chart Luke 3:10-14: crowd, share; tax collectors, honesty; soldiers, no extortion, contentment.

misconceptions.ask: What did John mean when he called Jesus "the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world"?
misconceptions.repair: Link with the lambs sacrificed in the temple and at Passover. Jesus would give his life for sin.

misconceptions.ask: In Luke 3:16, what did John say about the one coming after him?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 3:16 and John 1:30: "he was before me". Act untying sandals, a servant's job.

checks.question: What did John call Jesus in John 1:29?
checks.answer: The Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world

checks.question: What did John say the one coming would baptise with?
